scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "corepack pnpm --filter @gloomi/api dev" "corepack pnpm --filter @gloomi/web dev"
scripts.db:generate: corepack pnpm exec prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:migrate: corepack pnpm exec prisma migrate deploy --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:seed: corepack pnpm exec prisma db seed
